project.purpose: A simple, premium LinkedIn post image announcing that Prospkt.ai is launching soon.
project.primary_audience: service business owners, startup operators, AI/voice AI audience, local business automation buyers

safe_area.description: Keep all text and logo content comfortably inside the center 70% of the canvas.

logo.description: Black rounded-square Prospkt mark with white lightning bolt.
logo.usage: Use the logo mark centered above the wordmark. Do not recreate the lightning bolt in a different style.

style.corner_radius: soft rounded, similar to app icon

requirements: Use the same clean sans-serif feel as the Prospkt product UI.
Avoid futuristic, sci-fi, stretched, condensed, handwritten, serif, or overly rounded fonts.
Text must be crisp and easy to read at LinkedIn feed size.

forbidden_text: AI sales rep for service businesses
content.note: Keep the image itself extremely simple. Longer product context belongs in the LinkedIn caption, not on the graphic.

what_to_borrow: dark premium AI launch poster mood
dense LED halftone dot matrix background
cool blue and warm cream light glow
what_not_to_copy: do not copy the Miracle logo
do not use the exact sparkle placement
do not use a different brand font
do not make the text look generated or warped

background.texture: dense tiny circular LED/halftone dot matrix across the entire canvas
lighting: soft cool blue glow from upper-right or upper-center
soft warm cream glow from right side and/or lower-left
center should remain dark enough for white text to read clearly
depth: subtle blurred abstract light forms behind the dot grid
no heavy gradients that overpower the text

composition.alignment: all elements centered on the canvas

spacing.wordmark_to_launch_text: tight enough to read as one lockup
spacing.outer_padding: large negative space around the lockup

allowed: one or two very small white sparkle accents
not_allowed: cards or boxes around the main text

quality_bar: The word Prospkt.ai must be spelled correctly.
Typography should match the Prospkt app feel as closely as possible.
The logo should be centered and not distorted.
The image should still look good as a small LinkedIn feed thumbnail.
The background should add energy without competing with the text.

image_generation_prompt.prompt: Create a square 1200x1200 LinkedIn launch announcement graphic for Prospkt.ai. Premium dark AI startup launch poster. Deep black background with dense tiny circular LED halftone dot matrix texture across the whole image. Soft abstract cool blue and warm cream light glows behind the dots, with the center kept dark for readability. Centered vertical lockup: black rounded-square Prospkt mark with a white lightning bolt, then crisp white text exactly 'Prospkt.ai', then smaller widely spaced text exactly 'LAUNCHING SOON'. Use a modern clean sans-serif similar to Switzer/Inter, not a futuristic font. Minimal, polished, high contrast, brand-forward. No other text.
image_generation_prompt.negative_prompt: No people, no robots, no dashboards, no UI mockups, no phones, no browser windows, no planets, no classroom, no charts, no random symbols, no YALID text, no extra labels, no before/after layout, no misspellings, no distorted typography, no sci-fi font, no generic flyer style.

post_caption.recommended_copy:
Prospkt.ai launching soon.

For the past several months, we have been building Prospkt at YALID.

It is an AI sales rep and receptionist for service-based businesses, built to help follow up with leads, recover missed opportunities, book jobs, and keep every call, note, and next step organized.

More soon from the team at YALID.

export_checklist: Confirm text says exactly 'Prospkt.ai' and 'LAUNCHING SOON'.
Confirm no extra text appears in the image.
Confirm the logo is centered and not warped.
Confirm the dot texture is visible but not distracting.
Confirm the image is legible at small LinkedIn feed size.
